scientific_integrity: Minimality of the two counterexamples is checked exhaustively only over the finite ranges required, while the downstream divisibility is proved symbolically from the classical prime-power lcm formula. No independent audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The underlying Carmichael formula is classical; the new claim is the identification of the specific published misstatement, the least counterexamples in both branches, and the downstream dependency check. Literature non-detection cannot exclude an unindexed correction.
title: Two minimal counterexamples to a published Carmichael-function formula, with a downstream repair
